shared_elements: low-relief carved figures on a flat upright slab/pillar
bird-like creature with prominent beak/head in profile
band or register division of the surface
raised-relief figures against a plain background
justification: Both are upright slabs bearing low-relief figures in profile with some plant-like/foliate motif and a bird-headed element, but that is about as far as the correspondence goes. A shows stacked registers of schematic, blocky animals (quadrupeds, birds, a snake-like form) with no human presence, whereas B is dominated by a single large, anatomically detailed winged anthropomorphic figure with elaborate garment, musculature and a stylised tree — a completely different compositional scheme and rendering convention.
